_comment: Directed by Opus in Motion Studio from a sourced story (Nazi Germany's war in Europe 1939-1945), map documentary, 30 s. Render: Motion Studio > เรนเดอร์ > แผนช็อตตัวอย่าง > คอมไพล์, then เรนเดอร์. Borders are modern (approximations), no Nazi symbols.

artwork.style: clean flat vector illustration of real people with realistic human proportions and anatomy, crisp shapes, subtle cel shading, limited muted historical palette, editorial documentary infographic style, full body, dynamic natural pose
artwork.negative: cartoon, chibi, caricature, exaggerated proportions, watercolor, painterly, photo, photorealistic, 3d render, swastika, nazi symbol, insignia, emblem, flag, armband, medal, badge, gore, blood, weapon pointed at viewer

polish_soldier.prompt: a young Polish infantry soldier of 1939 in an olive-khaki wool uniform and a round steel helmet, kneeling behind cover and aiming his rifle to the left, determined face

paris_civilians.prompt: Parisian civilians fleeing in June 1940, a mother in a long coat pulling her young son by the hand while carrying a suitcase, walking fast, looking back over her shoulder, worried

soviet_soldier.prompt: a Soviet soldier at Stalingrad in winter 1943 in a quilted padded jacket and fur hat with ear flaps, advancing through snow, leaning forward with his rifle held across his chest, resolute face

allied_soldier.prompt: an Allied soldier landing at Normandy in June 1944, steel helmet with camouflage netting, wading ashore through knee-deep water, holding his rifle above his head with both hands

war_refugees.prompt: war refugees in 1945, an old man with a walking stick and a young woman carrying a bundle on her back, walking together slowly, weary faces

german_infantry.prompt: a 1939 infantry soldier in a plain field-grey uniform and a plain steel helmet with no markings, marching with a rifle on the shoulder, full body side view facing right

soviet_infantry.prompt: a 1945 Soviet infantry soldier in an olive-brown tunic and a plain steel helmet with no markings, marching with a rifle, full body side view facing right

bomber_plane.prompt: a 1940 twin-engine propeller bomber airplane in plain grey-green paint with no markings, seen from the side flying to the right

soviet_infantry_charge.prompt: a 1945 Soviet infantry soldier in an olive-brown tunic and a plain steel helmet with no markings, charging forward with his rifle held ready, full body side view facing right
